fix: canvas stretches when guard topology is collapsed/expanded

fix: canvas stretches when guard topology is collapsed/expanded

Root cause: floor height change via toggleGuard() grows #canvas-area
(flex:1), but the canvas pixel buffer (C.width/C.height) stays at the
old size. Browser then stretches the old buffer to fill the new CSS
height, distorting all shapes.

Fix: add resizeCanvas() — a lightweight resize that updates the canvas
buffer dimensions and reanchors node cluster targets (gx/gy) without
reinitializing node positions. toggleGuard() calls it after the 250ms
CSS transition completes via setTimeout(..., 270). Mobile tab switch
also uses resizeCanvas() instead of resize() so nodes don't jump when
returning to the brain tab.

fix: canvas node blobs and panel scroll not working

fix: canvas node blobs and panel scroll not working

Two root-cause bugs:

1. body was missing display:flex/flex-direction:column — without it,
   #workspace{flex:1} had no effect, making #canvas-area height
   unconstrained. The canvas getBoundingClientRect() returned bad
   dimensions so nodes were drawn at nonsensical positions/scales,
   appearing as tall vertical blobs.

2. Same layout collapse meant .side-body had no height ceiling, so
   overflow-y:auto never triggered and the drift log couldn't scroll.

Fixes:
- Add body{display:flex;flex-direction:column} and margin:0
- Use ctx.setTransform() instead of ctx.scale() to prevent transform
  accumulation on repeated resize calls
- Measure canvas-area (parent) not canvas element itself for dimensions
- Reset particles array on resize (prevents duplicate star field)
- Mobile: give .side a 55vh height so side-body can scroll on mobile too
